arguments.content: Advancing efficient and accurate real-time natural language processing (NLP) for low-resource environments is critical to enabling inclusive AI technologies accessible to underrepresented languages and communities globally. arguments.content: We propose a novel hybrid architecture that combines lightweight transformer models with adaptive sparsity techniques to optimize real-time NLP performance under strict computational constraints. Our approach integrates adaptive data augmentation tailored to low-resource languages and a reinforcement learning-based controller to dynamically balance accuracy and efficiency during inference. This method builds on our unpublished preliminary experiments demonstrating improved throughput and reduced latency without compromising model fidelity.

arguments.content: Our approach integrates adaptive data augmentation techniques from Lab-Gamma with reinforcement learning-based controllers to optimize real-time NLP model performance. We will incorporate these mechanisms into a hybrid architecture designed to handle the heterogeneity of non-IID data in federated learning settings.
